content:
We currently show the full path of the file in error messages:

── ✗ unexpected statement ─────────/Users/workmac/gitrepos/allroc/roc2/roc/main.roc:1:81

Zig and Rust don't do this and people would like shorter error messages in Roc, so is there a reason why we can't or shouldn't go with relative paths?
sounds good to me! :thumbs_up:
